gazetteer_names_needed.name: Chalcidice
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: the three-pronged peninsula east of Thessaloniki (Chalkidiki), ancient Chalcidice; the 18 resolve warnings of chalcidian-league are all this name

gaps.what: End of the Syracusan hold (bridged to 289, Agathocles's death) and start and end of the Bruttian occupation (bridged 289-277) are undated on the Crotone and Bruttii pages; the Agathocles page reports no capture of Croton in 295 (only an early defence of Croton against the Bruttii and a failed attempt to take it)

Extent and end of the 25-city confederation: the Crotone page gives coins of 480-460 and no end, the Sybaris page is silent on the 25 cities, the Italiote League page does not mention them; the loss at -444 is a reading dated by Thurii

The land of the 393/2 transfer and of the 385 transfer beyond Pella is not named, and the 32 cities are not listed; the Thessaloniki discs (25 and 40 km) and the Pella disc (30 km) are placeholders. Pella's fate at the dissolution of 379 is not on the Olynthus page (bridge, confidence 1)
The League's loss of Torone and Potidaea to Athens is undated; Potidaea was handed to the Olynthians by Philip in 356 (Olynthian War page); the expansion to 34 cities is undated; none is drawn

problems: Repair run of 2026-10-19 for croton and chalcidian-league only; the other thirteen dossiers of the batch were not touched. events_total and sources_total count only the two repaired dossiers.

Mirror events still missing in other groups' dossiers: syracuse has no Croton occupation (379-367, 295-289) and its -289 loss is generic; macedonian-empire has no events for the 385 transfer of Pella to the League, the 391 return of the 393/2 land, or the 379 return of Pella (chalcidian-league /ledger/1,2,7,8); peloponnesian-league ends the vassalage of the Chalcidians at -371 against -375 here ('Already in 375 BCE', Chalcidian League page).

Disagreement with the reviewer, set out in the notes file: the -379 losses of chalcidian-league are confidence 2 (Thermaic-coast cities) and 1 (Pella), not 3, because neither the Olynthus nor the League page lists the 32 cities or says what became of Pella in 379; croton's -444 loss is confidence 2 as the reviewer asked, but the Sybaris page does not say what became of the 25 cities.

New finding in the Chalcidian League page that the first version missed: Pella came with a second transfer 'eight years later' (393/2 + 8 = about 385), not with the 393/2 transfer, so Pella was removed from the 393-384 shape and from keyframe 4; the 393/2 land itself is unnamed and drawn as a placeholder disc round Thessaloniki.
Page conflict: the Crotone page has Croton fall to Agathocles in 295 BC; the Agathocles page has no such capture. The 295 event is kept at confidence 3 on the reviewer's spot check.
The Olynthian War page tried for the 383 expansion is about Philip II's campaign of 349-348 and does not cover it; it is listed in sources because it was opened.
